Quad Cities Superintendent Notice No. 27 
 
Page | 1  
 
                                                  
 
 
      
January 7, 2025 
 
SUBDIVISIONS: Davenport, Marquette, Muscatine, Ottumwa, Savanna 
NOTICES IN EFFECT: 1-19, 21-27 
NOTICES CANCELLED:     
SUBJECT: Cancellation of Superintendent Notice #20 
(Marquette – Coal Train Instructions) 
 
 
 
Effective immediately, Quad Cities Superintendent Notice #20 regarding (Marquette Coal Train Instructions) is hereby 
cancelled. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LOGAN IVES – ASST SUPERINTENDENT – QUAD CITIES 
Please contact your Employee Assistance Program at 1-833-594-0869 [or visit one.telushealth.com; Login: CP] for any social or 
personal problems that you or your family need assistance with.
